raw_text: Demo MVP: simple, readable, composable. ASP.NET Core 10 minimal APIs/EF Core; React 18 TypeScript/Vite/Tailwind; Docker Compose. Use clear names; no code comments - use descriptive method/class names instead. Uses Microsoft Testing Platform (not VSTest); snake_case tests; Testcontainers; NSubstitute. Dual auth, anti-forgery, user isolation; CSV import; Azure OpenAI; pgvector; background AI recommendations; NLP query assistance. `dotnet watch run`; `dotnet run -p tests/BudgetTracker.Api.Tests --output detailed --filter-query "/path/to/test"`; `dotnet ef migrations add MigrationName`; `dotnet ef database update`; `npm run dev`; `npm run build`; `npm run lint`; `docker compose up -d`; `docker compose down`. When one of the applications is started for testing, make sure it's stopped once finished.
